# accessible route

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:routeKindAccessible`](gmeow-routeKindAccessible.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/routeKindAccessible>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/connectivity`](../../slices/connectivity.md)
